result.markdown:
When looking for medical negligence or medical malpractice lawyers in Hobart, several well-established law firms specialize in personal injury and healthcare litigation.

[Blumers Personal Injury Lawyers](https://maps.google.com/?cid=4902891378687506519&g_mp=Cidnb29nbGUubWFwcy5wbGFjZXMudjEuUGxhY2VzLlNlYXJjaFRleHQ) handles complex medical negligence claims, including cases involving misdiagnosis, surgical errors, and birth trauma.

* Operates on a "no win, no fee" framework, funding upfront costs like expert medical reports.
* Offers dedicated local consultations (video, teleconference, or face-to-face) across Hobart.

[Slater and Gordon Lawyers Hobart](https://maps.google.com/?cid=10709339257891094391&g_mp=Cidnb29nbGUubWFwcy5wbGFjZXMudjEuUGxhY2VzLlNlYXJjaFRleHQ) is a prominent consumer law firm with a dedicated national and local medical law team.

* Specializes in securing compensation for substandard healthcare treatment and failure of duty of care.
* Provides complementary social work services alongside legal guidance to support clients through life-changing claims.

[*Phillips Taglieri](https://maps.google.com/?cid=499985996803637743&g_mp=Cidnb29nbGUubWFwcy5wbGFjZXMudjEuUGxhY2VzLlNlYXJjaFRleHQ) is noted as permanently closed.* Historically, this firm was widely recognized as being at the forefront of medical negligence and professional liability litigation in Tasmania.
